corrections: 'Kafka transactional producer + idempotent consumer offsets' -> offsets are committed inside the producer transaction; exactly-once only Kafka to Kafka (s-eos box)
SQS FIFO dedup gives exactly-once only within a 5-minute window and only for re-sends (s-sem box)
SQS maximum message size is 1 MiB since 2025-08-04, not 256 KB (s-kinds table)
Kafka producer idempotence default since 3.0, but a bug kept it off in 3.0.0 and 3.1.0 (s-eos)
Kafka client group.protocol still defaults to classic in 4.3 although KIP-848 is GA since 4.0 (s-kafka)
Kafka now has a queue mode: share groups, production-ready in 4.2 (s-kafka)
Celery acks before running by default (at-most-once); acks_late alone still acks on a killed worker (s-vt box)
Jepsen withdrew its claim that Kafka auto-commit loses data (penultimate-poll commits); the page does not claim it
unconfirmed_or_opinion: Rule of thumb on what to make async (s-why cost box): opinion
Whether KAFKA-17754 is fully closed after KIP-890 (s-eos): not checked
OpenAI's use of Temporal: only a vendor (Temporal) post quoting an OpenAI VP; no first-party source; the claim that Codex runs on Temporal is not made
